name: Isochronic
description: Each key is a tone, or a band of noise at the key, switched on and off evenly by one pulse that all keys share. Offset sets the right ear's pulse behind the left's.

params.name: Rate
params.description: Pulses a second in each ear, shared by all keys. Slow is a plain on and off; fast runs together into a flutter. Moving it starts a glide again.

params.name: Duty
params.description: The share of each period the sound is on. Low is short blips with long gaps; high is long tones with short gaps.

params.name: Edge
params.description: How long each pulse takes to fade in and to fade out. Short is hard, long is soft. It is held to half of the shorter of the on time and the gap.

params.name: Depth
params.description: How far the sound drops between pulses. At full the gaps are silent; lower leaves the sound running under the pulse; at zero there is no pulse.

params.name: Offset
params.description: How far the right ear's pulse runs behind the left's. At 180 the ears take turns. Speakers or mono add the two, and at 180 with half Duty the pulse is gone.

params.name: Warmth
params.description: Adds the second and third partials to the tone. At zero the tone is a pure sine; higher is fuller and brighter. The noise of Air is not changed.

params.name: Air
params.description: Crossfades each key's tone into a band of noise centred on the key. At zero only the tone sounds; at full only the noise.

params.name: Target
params.description: The rate the pulse glides to when Glide is above zero. Moving it starts the glide again.

params.name: Glide
params.description: Minutes the pulse takes to go from Rate to Target, from the first key on. Zero is off. Moving it starts the glide again from Rate.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long a key takes to fade in under the pulses.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long a key takes to fade out after it is let go.

origin.note: Written for this library on cpp/kit: the pulse shape, the pulse gate, the slow clock and the rate glide are kit/beat.h, the noise streams are kit/colour.h.
